correctness.evidence: Independent exact Hochster/homology census over 112 connected six-vertex atlas graphs reproduced reg 67/45, pd 4/64/44, 55 distinct tables, the frequency-8 mode, all matching statistics, and the witness.

originality.evidence: Targeted exact-count/title searches did not locate this specific complete 112-graph Betti compilation; standard formulas, graph counts, and matching bounds are prior art.

value.evidence: The work is a tiny exhaustive catalog using standard formulas and known bounds, with no new structural theorem, obstruction, asymptotic regime, or algorithmic advance; its main utility is regression data.
